verdicts.quote: A freed spot books the first eligible waitlisted member directly and notifies them; the member may cancel under the existing rules.

Order is join order; leaving and rejoining goes to the end; no priority tier. … each entry gets a per-class, strictly increasing sequence value when it is appended … staff manual promote or reorder (G-5).
Automatic promotion, no claim window. … the member may cancel under the existing rules. … The waitlist is free: no fee, penalty or no-show rule … an ordinary booking, tagged "Booked from waitlist"
M2 cancels at 09:00 UTC. After the cancel returns: booked set exactly {M1, M3, M4}; waitlist exactly [M5]; M5 is #1
through the existing booking channel … A spot opened up and you've been booked into Spin on Tue 1 Dec at 18:00. … the booking and removal still commit … a `notify_failed` event
C7 capacity 2, booked {M1, M2}, waitlist [M3, M4, M5]; M1 and M2 cancel concurrently: exactly M3 and M4 booked (each once); booked {M3, M4}; waitlist [M5] with M5 #1
One spot per member per class … A member who becomes booked in a class by any path has that class's entry removed. … a direct booking cannot take a spot ahead of an open waitlist
Class full, open, waitlist already has 10 entries | `WAITLIST_FULL`: "The waitlist for this class is full (10 of 10)."
Cutoff is **60 minutes** before the class start instant; closed at and after that instant … From the cutoff instant no one can join and no one is promoted.
staff raise capacity to 4: M3 and M4 promoted in that order; M5 is #1 … A capacity decrease below the booked count does not touch entries.
When a class is cancelled, every entry is removed and each member notified
An entry holds only the member ID, class ID and join order. … position is the count of entries with a lower sequence, plus one. … None (derived) | Closed
verdicts.missing: The sequence establishes order, but the record omits the time the member joined.

verdicts.quote: When the class start passes, the class has no waitlist label … Entries are deleted with the class's booking records under the existing retention
No payload, page or message sent to a member includes another member's name, email or ID; the only information about others is the aggregate count and own position.
Whether staff need to see or edit waitlists. Left out, not decided … staff manual promote or reorder (G-5).
verdicts.missing: Staff access to the list and manual promotion or removal are deferred. No staff-facing history identifies who was promoted and when.

verdicts.quote: after any join, leave or cancel response returns, the next read by any client reflects it (read-your-write; no delayed promotion)

For a class with a free spot, booking, cancelling and viewing behave exactly as before this change … Out of scope: staff views, reports, migration of historical data (no entries exist before this change), reset of existing bookings.
Each full class card and detail view shows the viewer one of these states … Full, open, 0 waiting | "Full · be the first on the waitlist" | Join waitlist … no entries exist before this change
